name: avatar-circles

frames.best_why: The whole row is crisp and unobstructed, from the first avatar through the +99 disc.

tagline: A row of circular photos overlaps into a white +99 disc.
summary: A compact avatar group where round photos overlap shoulder to shoulder and end in a light disc showing how many more people there are.
appearance: Five round photos lined up on black, each cropped to a circle and ringed with a thin white border. They overlap by about a third, and a solid white circle holding +99 in black caps the row.
behaviour: Static: the row does not move or respond in the frames. The trailing count is a link whose background darkens on hover.
demo_content: Five soft landscape photos followed by a white +99 disc.
use_when: A compact group of users plus a count is needed as social proof or a member preview.
avoid_when: The trailing count disc ships with an empty link, so it goes nowhere until you wire it up.
customise: Pass avatarUrls as an array of imageUrl and profileUrl pairs plus numPeople for the trailing count; ring colour, size and overlap are fixed classes.
weight_why: A short row of small images and one text label; nothing animates.

a11y.note: Photos get generic alt text like Avatar 1, the count disc has no accessible name, and the links have no visible focus style.

issues: The +99 disc is an anchor with an empty href, so clicking it goes nowhere.
polish_why: Clean overlap and rings, but the demo's landscape photos do not read as people.
title: Avatar Circles
